app.title: Secure Word Encoder
app.subtitle: Encrypted encoding using Russian words dictionary

notifications.setPassword: Please set a password in Settings

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.passwordDescription: This password will be used to encrypt and decrypt your data. Keep it safe!
encryption.cipherDescription: Encryption algorithm used to secure your data.
encryption.compressionDescription: Choose compression algorithm. Deflate offers better compression than Gzip.

encoder.title: Encoder / Decoder
encoder.dictionarySourceDescription: Choose between built-in dictionaries or provide your own custom word list.
encoder.selectDictionaryDescription: Choose from pre-generated Russian word dictionaries of various sizes.
encoder.customWordListDescription: Enter your words separated by commas or newlines. Dictionary size must be a power of 2 (e.g., 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024).
encoder.customWordListPlaceholder:
word1, word2, word3
or one word per line...

whatIs.title: What is Word Encoding?
whatIs.description: It's a method to represent binary data using a dictionary of words, making it more human-readable and memorable than traditional encoding schemes like Base64.

compression.title: Data Compression
compression.description: Before encryption, your text is compressed using algorithms like Gzip or Deflate. This reduces the overall size of the data, making the final output shorter.

encryption.title: AES-256 Encryption
encryption.description: Your data is encrypted using the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) with a 256-bit key. The key is derived from your password using PBKDF2, a robust key-stretching algorithm.

wordMapping.title: Binary to Word Mapping
wordMapping.description: The encrypted binary data is split into chunks. Each chunk's value is used as an index to pick a word from the selected dictionary. For a dictionary of {{size}} words, each word represents {{bits}} bits of data.
